name: 00_lookup_tenant_config

nodes.name: Manual Trigger (For Testing)
nodes.notes: ⚠️ TESTING ONLY: This workflow is normally called by other workflows. Use this trigger for testing with sample data.

nodes.name: Add Test Data (Testing Only)
nodes.notes: ⚠️ TESTING: Provides default test data when triggered manually. Edit tenant_id here to test with different values.

nodes.name: Guard Rail #1: Extract tenant_id
nodes.notes: Extract tenant_id from webhook query param or body. Reference: docs/core/verified-research-findings.md PART 1 Pattern #1

nodes.name: Guard Rail #2: Validate tenant_id
nodes.notes: Validate tenant_id format and detect if UUID or TEXT. Accepts both for API flexibility.

nodes.name: Resolve Tenant Lookup
nodes.notes: Resolve tenant lookup URL based on input type (UUID or TEXT). Always outputs UUID.

nodes.name: Guard Rail #3: Verify tenant exists
nodes.notes: Verify tenant exists and is_active. Supports both UUID and TEXT (phone/name) lookup.

nodes.name: Guard Rail #4: Load tenant config
nodes.notes: Load tenant config using tenant_uuid (UUID FK). Reference: docs/core/verified-research-findings.md PART 1 Pattern #3

notes: ✅ UTILITY: Reusable workflow for tenant config lookup with guard rails. Implements research-locked pattern from docs/core/verified-research-findings.md PART 1 Pattern #3. Guard rails: Extract → Validate → Verify → Load → Return
